requirements.name: Dynamic commission rate calculation
requirements.summary: System must calculate and apply variable commission percentages based on store agreements and order value.

requirements.name: Real-time revenue share reconciliation
requirements.summary: System must continuously reconcile platform revenue shares against store partner settlements in real-time.

requirements.name: Automated tax calculation and collection
requirements.summary: System must automatically compute and collect applicable taxes based on jurisdiction and product type.

requirements.name: Multi-currency transaction conversion
requirements.summary: System must handle currency conversion and settlement for cross-border or multi-currency transactions.

requirements.name: Financial audit trail generation
requirements.summary: System must generate immutable audit logs for all financial transactions and settlement events.

requirements.name: Scheduled settlement batch processing
requirements.summary: System must execute periodic batch processing to finalize and distribute funds to partners and providers.

requirements.name: Fraudulent transaction flagging
requirements.summary: System must identify and flag suspicious financial patterns requiring manual review before settlement.

requirements.name: Refund and chargeback impact analysis
requirements.summary: System must calculate and adjust financial records when refunds or chargebacks occur post-settlement.
